title: Session 02
abstract: An introduction to variational calculus and Nash equilibrium, covering the Lagrangian formulation, robotic arm simulation, and the conceptual foundations of Nash equilibrium through practical examples.

title: Session 03
abstract: Tensors briefly in the context of General Relativity, and a simplified example of how Modern Quantum Magnetometry works using NV diamonds and ODMR.

title: Session 04
abstract: In this session, Luke has the the first lecture of a three part series on proving the Nash Equilibrium. He begins with the intuition behind the proof. Burak answers some of the everyday questions we all experience but rarely take the time to stop and think about.
